ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The non-arrow part in the figure shows an acyl fragment R-C(=O)-, with the carbonyl carbon connected to a nitrogen bearing H, then connected to another nitrogen bearing H, and subsequently connected to a sulfonyl group S(=O)2-Ar; at the lower left there is also a B: species not bonded to the main skeleton. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, the skeleton can be written as R-C(=O)-NH-NH-SO2-Ar. According to the method in the question, represent R with the SMILES dummy atom *, and regard Ar as phenyl c1ccccc1; the acylhydrazide sulfonyl-containing fragment is written as *C(=O)NNS(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1. Since B: is a separate species, connect it with a dot and write it as [B], obtaining *C(=O)NNS(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1.[B].

method.method_draft: First identify the non-arrow skeleton in the image as R-C(=O)-NH-NH-SO2-Ar with a disconnected B: species. Replace R by the SMILES dummy atom * and Ar by phenyl c1ccccc1. planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct and essentially unique route: transcribe the displayed skeletal structure while explicitly disregarding the curved arrows, then encode the resulting connectivity as SMILES. Other approaches would mostly be paraphrases because the task is a structure-to-SMILES conversion.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the visible atoms and connectivity: an R group attached to a carbonyl carbon, the carbonyl carbon single-bonded to N, that N single-bonded to another N, the second N single-bonded to an SO2Ar sulfonyl group, plus a separate base labeled B:. Ignore all curved arrows. Interpret Ar as a phenyl ring in the expected generic representation.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to provide the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and specifically to ignore the arrows; no other textual chemical data are needed.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions for generic substituents and fragments: represent R as dummy atom *, carbonyl as C(=O), the two singly bonded nitrogens as NN with implicit hydrogens, sulfonyl phenyl as S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1, and the separate base fragment as .[B].
